sentence: This project studies the geometry and topology of deep neural networks to make them easier to understand and more reliable in medical imaging.
This project designs ways for teams of robots to explore and inspect tight, confined spaces such as aircraft wings and ship compartments.
This project works on smarter devices that analyze data, learn from it, and make decisions in coordination with other devices.
This project builds tools that identify the exact structure of a single trapped molecule, including whether it is left-handed or right-handed.
This project studies how CRISPR endonucleases and their analogues work and how natural inhibitor proteins regulate them.
This project studies how methylation is added to DNA in a unicellular eukaryote and how it affects gene regulation.
This project studies how moths and fruit flies sense the chemical signals they use to find mates.
This project runs a robotic laboratory that designs, makes, and tests alloys on its own, using artificial intelligence.
This project uses machine learning to find a better way to measure differences in how people pronounce words, tested on bilingual speakers.
This project builds a mathematical framework based on convex optimization to explain how deep neural networks make decisions and to make them more reliable.
This project develops meta-learning methods that learn how to control complex factory systems linked by wireless networks.
This project grows semiconductor particles inside the periplasm of bacteria to study how they interact and to increase chemical production.
This project builds computer methods for solving the Boltzmann equation, which describes how rarefied gases and plasma move.
This project builds tools that find latent information in data despite unknown nonlinear distortions.
